about: Question of the day. General interview questions (not job- or college-specific), written for teens with little or no work experience. The site picks one per local day: days since startDate, modulo the list length, looping when it runs out. Add new questions at the END so earlier days keep their question. note = what the interviewer is really asking.

questions.q: Tell me about yourself.
questions.note: Give me a quick, real picture of who you are and what you're into.

questions.q: What's one thing you're really good at?
questions.note: Can you name a strength and back it up with an example?

questions.q: Tell me about a time something didn't go the way you planned.
questions.note: How do you react when things go wrong?

questions.q: Why do you want this?
questions.note: Have you actually thought about why you're here?

questions.q: How do you handle having a lot to do at once?
questions.note: Can you stay organized and calm when you're busy?

questions.q: If you could have any job for one day, what would it be?
questions.note: What do you get excited about, and can you think on your feet?

questions.q: What's one question you'd ask me about this place?
questions.note: Are you curious, and did you think ahead?

questions.q: How would your friends describe you?
questions.note: How do you come across to people who know you well?

questions.q: What's something you're working on getting better at?
questions.note: Can you be honest about a weakness and show you're improving?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you worked with a group.
questions.note: Do you pull your weight and get along with people?

questions.q: What are you hoping to learn in the next year?
questions.note: Do you have goals, and do you like to grow?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you had a tight deadline.
questions.note: What do you do when time is short?

questions.q: What's something you've taught yourself?
questions.note: Do you go after things on your own?

questions.q: What would you want to know about a typical day here?
questions.note: Can you ask a useful, specific question?

questions.q: What do you like to do when you have free time?
questions.note: What are you like outside of school or work?

questions.q: What would a teacher say is your best quality?
questions.note: Can you see yourself the way others do?

questions.q: Tell me about a mistake you made and what you did next.
questions.note: Do you own your mistakes and fix them?

questions.q: What made you interested in applying?
questions.note: Is there a real reason, or did you just apply everywhere?

questions.q: What do you do when you feel nervous?
questions.note: Do you know how to steady yourself?

questions.q: What's the best advice anyone has ever given you?
questions.note: What have you learned from the people around you?

questions.q: What would you ask to find out if this is a good fit for you?
questions.note: Are you choosing us too, not just hoping we pick you?

questions.q: What's something people are surprised to learn about you?
questions.note: Is there more to you than what's on paper?

questions.q: Tell me about a skill you've built outside of school.
questions.note: Where have you learned things on your own time?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you helped someone.
questions.note: Do you notice when others need a hand?

questions.q: Where do you see yourself in a few years?
questions.note: Are you thinking about your future at all? It's fine not to have it all figured out.

questions.q: Tell me about a time you had to stay calm when others weren't.
questions.note: Can you keep your head when things get tense?

questions.q: If you could learn any skill instantly, what would it be and why?
questions.note: What matters to you, and can you explain your thinking?

questions.q: What would you ask about how people here learn and get better?
questions.note: Do you care about growing?

questions.q: What's a subject or topic you could talk about for an hour?
questions.note: What lights you up?

questions.q: What makes you a good teammate?
questions.note: Can you give a specific reason, not just 'I'm nice'?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you disagreed with someone.
questions.note: Can you disagree without it turning into a fight?

questions.q: What does doing a good job mean to you?
questions.note: What standards do you hold yourself to?

questions.q: How do you decide what to do first when everything feels urgent?
questions.note: Can you set priorities?

questions.q: What's something you've changed your mind about?
questions.note: Are you open to new ideas?

questions.q: What's a question you'd ask me about my own experience here?
questions.note: Are you interested in the person across the table?

questions.q: Walk me through your week. What keeps you busy?
questions.note: How do you spend your time, and can you manage it?

questions.q: What's your biggest weakness?
questions.note: Can you be honest without hurting yourself, and show you're working on it?

questions.q: Tell me about something you're proud of.
questions.note: What did you do, and why did it matter to you?

questions.q: Why should we pick you?
questions.note: Can you connect what you offer to what we need, without bragging?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you got feedback you didn't like.
questions.note: Can you take criticism and use it?

questions.q: Describe yourself in three words.
questions.note: Can you choose words and explain one quickly?

questions.q: What would you ask about what makes someone do well here?
questions.note: Do you want to know how to succeed?

questions.q: What's something you care a lot about?
questions.note: What matters to you, and why?

questions.q: Are you more of a planner or someone who figures it out as you go?
questions.note: Do you know how you work best?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you had to learn something quickly.
questions.note: How do you handle something brand new?

questions.q: What gets you out of bed on a hard day?
questions.note: What keeps you going?

questions.q: What would you do if you realized you'd made a mistake no one else noticed?
questions.note: Are you honest when no one's watching?

questions.q: What's a book, show or video that taught you something?
questions.note: Are you curious, and can you explain what you learned?

questions.q: What would you ask about the next steps after this interview?
questions.note: Do you follow through?

questions.q: What's a responsibility you have at home or in your community?
questions.note: Can people count on you?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you were reliable when it counted.
questions.note: Do you show up?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you had to work with someone you didn't get along with.
questions.note: Can you stay professional with anyone?

questions.q: What do you want to get out of this opportunity?
questions.note: Do you know what you're looking for?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you had to speak up.
questions.note: Will you say something when it matters?

questions.q: If you ran your school for a day, what would you change?
questions.note: Do you notice problems and think about fixes?

questions.q: What would you ask to understand what this place values most?
questions.note: Do you care about fitting in with the culture?

questions.q: What's been the best part of your year so far?
questions.note: What are you excited about right now?

questions.q: What's a compliment you've gotten that meant a lot to you?
questions.note: What do others value in you?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you took the lead.
questions.note: Will you step up when no one else does?

questions.q: Tell me about a goal you set and reached.
questions.note: Can you set a goal and follow through?

questions.q: How do you handle a customer, teacher or adult who's upset with you?
questions.note: Can you stay respectful and solve the problem?

questions.q: What's something you'd love to get better at, just for fun?
questions.note: What are you curious about?

questions.q: What would you ask about the hardest part of this role or program?
questions.note: Can you handle an honest answer?

questions.q: Who's someone you look up to, and why?
questions.note: What qualities do you admire?

questions.q: What's one thing you'd bring here that most people wouldn't?
questions.note: What makes you different?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you had to keep going after you wanted to quit.
questions.note: Do you stick with hard things?

questions.q: What kind of place do you work or learn best in?
questions.note: Do you know what you need to do well?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you had to juggle school and something else.
questions.note: Can you balance more than one thing?

questions.q: What's the most interesting thing you've learned this month?
questions.note: Are you paying attention to the world?

questions.q: What would you ask about what you'd be doing in your first week?
questions.note: Are you picturing yourself here?

questions.q: What's one thing you want me to remember about you?
questions.note: Can you sum yourself up clearly?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you solved a problem on your own.
questions.note: Can you figure things out without being told?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you failed at something.
questions.note: Can you be honest about failing and show what you learned?

questions.q: What would make this worth it for you?
questions.note: What do you actually want?

questions.q: What would you do if you didn't understand what you were asked to do?
questions.note: Will you ask for help instead of guessing?

questions.q: Sell me something you own.
questions.note: Can you think fast and explain why something is worth it?

questions.q: What would you ask me about what I like most about being here?
questions.note: Can you build a real conversation?

questions.q: What's a challenge you've faced outside of school?
questions.note: What has shaped you?

questions.q: How do you stay organized?
questions.note: Do you have a system, even a simple one?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you went above what was asked.
questions.note: Do you do more than the minimum?

questions.q: What does success look like to you?
questions.note: What are you working toward?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you were really stressed. What helped?
questions.note: Do you know how to manage stress?

questions.q: If you had to teach a class on anything, what would it be?
questions.note: What do you know well enough to explain?

questions.q: What's a question you'd ask to end an interview on a good note?
questions.note: Can you close strong?

questions.q: What's something you've done that you didn't think you could?
questions.note: Do you push past your comfort zone?

questions.q: How do you make someone new feel welcome?
questions.note: Are you kind and aware of others?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you had to change your plans at the last minute.
questions.note: Can you adapt?

questions.q: Why is now the right time for you to do this?
questions.note: Are you ready?

questions.q: What would you do if a teammate wasn't doing their part?
questions.note: Can you handle it fairly without drama?

questions.q: What's something small that always makes your day better?
questions.note: Can you be yourself for a second?

questions.q: Do you have any questions for me?
questions.note: Always have one ready. 'No' can sound like you're not interested.
